safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated allergies section is empty and does not mention penicillin allergy.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of a beta-lactam antibiotic, which may precipitate an immediate hypersensitivity reaction including anaphylaxis. This is a high-risk safety omission because the resulting harm can be rapid and life-threatening if the allergy is not visible to downstream clinicians.
